questions.question: In 42, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: The Brooklyn Dodgers executive who signs Robinson. Chadwick Boseman plays Jackie. 2013.

questions.question: In 42, Ford’s Branch Rickey runs which baseball team?
questions.note: Rickey signs Jackie Robinson. Ford wears the eyebrows and the growl.

questions.question: In Ender’s Game, what is Ford’s military rank and surname?
questions.note: Hyrum Graff, who recruits Ender. Asa Butterfield is Ender. 2013, from Orson Scott Card.

questions.question: In Cowboys & Aliens, what is Ford’s character?
questions.note: Colonel Woodrow Dolarhyde. He is not used to taking orders, including from a stranger with a weird bracelet.

questions.question: In Captain America: Brave New World, which MCU role does Harrison Ford take?
questions.note: President Thaddeus Ross. In the movie he hulks out as Red Hulk.

questions.question: In The Call of the Wild (2020), what is Ford’s prospector named?
questions.note: From Jack London’s novel. Buck is a CGI dog. Chris Sanders directed.

questions.question: In Six Days, Seven Nights, what is Ford’s Quinn Harris’s job?
questions.note: He flies a beat-up plane in the South Pacific. Then it goes down.

questions.question: In The Devil’s Own, what is Ford’s Tom O’Meara?
questions.note: He takes in a boarder who is secretly an IRA gunman. It goes badly at the dinner table.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, what is Ford’s Norman Spencer hiding?
choices: That the house is not his
questions.note: His wife thinks the house is haunted. The ghost is the student. He tries to drown Claire in the tub.

questions.question: In K-19: The Widowmaker, what does Ford’s Captain Vostrikov command?
questions.note: The reactor fails. He is the hard-ass sent to make the boat combat-ready.
